confirmLeaveLogonTitle.text: The remote computer will stay signed in

confirmLeaveLogonBody.text: If you disconnect without logging off, the remote computer stays signed in. Anyone at that screen can keep working as the signed-in account. Your console sign-in here is not affected.

confirmLogoffBlockedBody.text: This product cannot sign the remote computer off for this connection yet. There is no logoff path. You can disconnect only — the remote computer stays signed in. Your console sign-in here is not affected.

confirmLogoffAttemptBody.text: This will try to sign the remote computer off, then close this view. Sign-off is not guaranteed. Your console sign-in here is not affected.

confirmDisconnectStay.text: Disconnect ends the live channel for every participant and returns you to the page you connected from.

confirmLeaveOtTitle.text: The remote device may keep running

confirmLeaveOtBody.text: If you disconnect without a logoff, the remote device or process may keep running. This product cannot sign an OT device off. Your console sign-in here is not affected.

endPolicyWhyAsk.text: Disconnect closes this view. The remote computer may stay signed in. Log off tries to end that sign-in, then closes this view. Privileged connections default to Log off. Your console sign-in here is not affected.

noLiveSessionId.text: No live session id — use Open session (Connection points) or Connect (My Workstations) before connecting. The zero UUID is not a valid session.

panHelpDrag.text: Drag to pan. Arrow keys pan; +/− zoom; 0 fits. Ctrl+wheel zooms.

panHelpKeys.text: Arrow keys pan; +/− zoom; 0 fits. Ctrl+wheel zooms. Space is reserved for remote input.

exitChordSet.text: Exit full screen key set to {{chord}}

sshViewportAria.text: SSH terminal font size and full screen

policyReadonlyHint.text: Clipboard and file copy follow the policy set for you and this computer.

waitingSupervisorYou.text: Waiting for you to join. The operator cannot type until you join.

waitingSupervisorOp.text: Waiting for a supervisor. You cannot type until they join.

rdpBlankDesktop.text: Connected — the remote desktop is still black. Press Ctrl+Alt+Del or click the screen and press a key.

vncWaitingFrames.text: Connected — waiting for the remote desktop to appear.

fileTransferHint.text: Send copies the file to the remote computer. SSH uses SFTP into aic-transfer in the account home. Windows Remote Desktop uses the user profile aic-transfer folder.

uploadFile.text: Send file to the remote computer

clearTooltip.text: {{label}} is your default page after sign-in. Click to use Dashboard instead.
